snippet.title: This game DISAPPEARS if you pause it!
snippet.description:
DISCLAIMER: please watch this video on 1080p, even if your screen can't display resolutions this high. On lower resolutions the effect may not work.

The video has some artifacting because of video compression sadly. Luckily it doesn't hurt the effect and there is no issue when the effect is running on your pc.

Download the demo here:
https://github.com/brantagames/noise-shader

More about the effect:
https://youtu.be/TdTMeNXCnTs?feature=shared
https://youtu.be/MuVqbnEXXIg?feature=shared

Cool video about the Pulfrich Effect:
https://youtu.be/Q-v4LsbFc5c?feature=shared

Music used:
Wall Is Stop - Baba Is You Soundtrack

#gamedev #godot #shaders

00:22 Sliding effect
01:04 Colorful cycling effect
01:58 Demos
02:08 Donut outline
02:20 Slow sliding
02:36 Shimmying
02:47 Colorful noise patterns
03:02 Hue steps and hue offset
